capabilities: Rename a note and rewrite backlinks to the new title
Keep the old title as the link display text
Store the old title as an alias
Rename a linked note from the cursor without opening it
Sync the first heading and a frontmatter title key with the new name
disambiguation: Not a bulk or pattern-based file renamer; it renames a single note and updates the links pointing to it.
extras: Documentation is a demo vault that ships with each release and can be opened with a command; beta builds are installed through BRAT.
intentEvidence: Obsidian's own renames ask what they are for.
problem: Renaming a note silently changes the words readers see in links, so carefully written prose ends up saying something the author did not write.

relations.evidence: Covers part of it: also renames a link's target from the cursor
Different trigger: a rename rather than a sync command; adds: old title kept in backlinks
Opposite goal: links keep the old display text instead of following the new title

summary: Note renamer that rewrites links to the new title while keeping the old title as their display text and as an alias.
